events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Welcome to the Old World
events.text: You are the leader of a young nation in an Old World - an Old World full of established powers that have not heard of you... yet. Select your Settler and found your Capital City. You'll choose your nation and decide which Family manages your first City, gaining their advantages immediately.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], first of the Mauryan Dynasty. Born under Nanda rule, you quickly rose to the rank of General before being exiled by a jealous King. This was Nanda’s greatest mistake. Alongside your childhood tutor, adviser, and friend, [character], you raised an army of mercenaries and bandits and piece by piece you dismantled the empire. Now you have overthrown the unpopular Nanda rulers and seized control. The people look to you for guidance as both a mighty warrior and a just ruler. May your reign be the start of a new age for the people of [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] Nanda, sole ruler and Destroyer of the Kshastriyas. Your usurpation of the throne of Magadha was a thorough and complete triumph. None are left to question your rule. Yet, out of earshot, the court argues about your mysterious lineage. Are you the bastard son of a royal, or a low-born child of a courtesan and a barber? Either way, all agree that your background has no bearing on your abilities. With the royal armies of Magadha at your disposal, you have started to push the boundaries of the kingdom further than ever before, cutting a bloody swathe through your enemies. You know that this is just the beginning. Go forth, son of Magadha, and show the world the power of the Nanda dynasty.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Queen of the Satavahanas. With the death of your husband [character], the people look to you to rule in his place. Your sons are still in their infancy and it will be many years until they are ready to take the throne. Despite the chaos, you remain calm. It is through the rites and rituals of your people that stability and order may be found. These are dangerous times, but it falls to you to lead your people and rise above the surrounding threats. The traditions of the Satavahanas shall never be extinguished.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Gupta Princess and Queen of Vakataka. You never expected to rule, especially after being married off to a foreign court. However, now that you sit upon the throne you are quickly adapting to the new responsibilities that come with it. They suit you well. As you swiftly take control of the court of this new nation, you are still proud of your Gupta heritage, the tight bonds with your father and brother securing your claim to the throne. It is an exciting new age of art and culture. It is time to make your mark on the world.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], recently given the title of Augusta by the senate and given powers of rule beyond any other woman in Rome. At the same time, your husband [character] grip on power slips away by the day. As a direct descendant of Emperor Augustus, you wield the respect of the nobles along with a formidable grasp of statecraft. Both diplomacy and subversion are reasonable tools to achieve your ambitions, and of one fact you are certain: Your son [character] will be the next to rule, no matter what it takes.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: Rome has been reshaped in your image, [character]. With the death of Marc Anthony the way lay clear for you to seize power and now, granted title upon title by the senate, you are Imperator for life, first amongst equals and the adopted son of the newly divine Julius Caesar. None may dispute your rule. Matters of succession may be more difficult. Your daughter [character] has been exiled for adultery and treason after consorting with would-be assassins. Will you forgive this wanton rebellion or will you look to elsewhere in your dynasty, adopting a child to make them heir to your empire?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: It is unusual for a statesman of Rome to be named Consul twice, yet you, [character], have held the office over five times. The Senate know that you are capable of overcoming any threat to Rome. Proving your prowess in wars close to Rome and further afield, much of your focus has been on improving the Roman armies in battle, placing emphasis on the roles of generals like the young and talented [character]. With you at the helm, there are many improvements to be made. But stay wary, [character]. Rome has many more threats to face…

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: It is no secret that you, [character], control Rome. A new political alliance with [character], a powerful yet unsteady ally, has been sealed through marriage to your daughter [character]. Now your focus has turned to new frontiers. To sustain support and to keep power from the senate, you will need to expand the borders of Rome to gain riches and the loyalty of your troops. Rome looks to you, [character]. Go, see, and conquer.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: Harsh to your foes and generous to your friends, the senate has called on you to see Rome through this tough time, [character]. You are renown as the greatest general at Rome’s disposal, fighting with a cunning and wit not seen before. Although not without detractors in the senate, it is said that the gods of Rome favor you above all others, and your results on the field are unquestionable. With your grandson [character] already shaping up to be a capable leader, go forth and show the world that Rome is a force to be feared.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], favored of Venus and dictator of Rome. Returning from your wars abroad, you found Rome in the grasp of the populares led by your former superior [character] and, after a fierce and violent fight, took it by force. Power is now yours, although your grasp on control is thin. [character] has been exiled but remains a lurking threat, seeking a way back to Rome. Meanwhile in the city the noble families are also disinclined to accept your rule. You have used violence to gain your seat. It will likely also be needed to keep it…

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Alli, Pandya Queen of [rival]. The popular tale is that you came from an immaculate birth, found on a lily at the end of a ritual by your father. The only child of the King, you have trained in warfare and the arts of kingship. Having defeated a pretender to the throne, you have finally taken the mantle for yourself. Your legend is just beginning. The fate of [rival] falls to you, to forge a land that will be remembered in ages past.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the great king chosen to lead Assyria into the Old World. Named to rule before your elder brother, [character], the legacy of Assyria is now in your capable hands. Surrounded by enemies, you will need to use every skill at your disposal to help Assyria grow into the glorious empire your ancestors envisioned. The existing civilizations of this Old World do not yet know the glory and power of Assyria, but they are about to find out.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Aššur-uballiṭ (<font="Sinacherib SDF">𒁹𒀭𒀸𒋩𒋾𒆷</font>), King of Assyria. Under your rule Assyria will be firmly established as a great power, comparable to the greatest nations of the Old World. Shrewd diplomat and not afraid to use force to assert your claims if necessary, you will not let Assyria's status as a major power be denied.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Šarru-kīn II (<font="Sinacherib SDF">𒁹𒈗𒄀𒈾</font>), the legitimate king. A great warrior and a just king, leading from the front and through example, you increased the status of women and scribes at your court, pardoned some of your defeated enemies, and worked to assimilate conquered people into your own. Inspired by the great Epics and legendary rulers of old, you will lead Assyria into a golden age and change the Old World forever.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Sammu-Rāmat (<font="Sinacherib SDF">𒊩𒊓𒄠𒈬𒊏𒆳</font>), powerful queen of the Neo-Assyrian empire. One of the most powerful women of your age, you've been on military campaigns and it is now your time to expand the dominion of Assyria in the Old World. Renowned both for military conquests and as a legendary founder and builder, your figure will be turned into myths and legends, and your accomplishments will resonate through history for ages to come.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Tukulti-Ninurta (<font="Sinacherib SDF">𒁹𒄑𒆪𒋾𒀭𒊩𒌆𒅁</font>), first of the name, King of Kings. By your very name, your dedication to the warrior god Ninurta (<font="Sinacherib SDF">𒀭𒊩𒌆𒅁</font>) guides you to fearsome military achievements. Leading from the front, you will honor the memory of your father [character] by conquering all before you. Your sons fear you and conspire for the throne: you will do well to keep an eye on them. While conspirators lurk in the shadow of your great might, let you establish Assyria as a power to respect in the Old World.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], wisest [title] of Babylonia. The myths of your people claim that you descend from a distant line of kings, but your people are broken and battered from disasters. Finally taking your birthright, it falls on you to lead the people of Babylonia into the Old World to forge a nation of knowledge and glory, one that will be remembered through the ages. The existing civilizations of this Old World do not yet know the splendor and wisdom of Babylonia, but they will learn.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Adad-Gûppî (𒊩𒀭𒅎𒄖𒌒𒉿𒀪), sometimes called Addagoppe by foreigners. Priestess of Sîn (𒀭𒌍), descendant of a long line of powerful rulers, daughter of a great king and mother of the next, you have assumed the mantle of ruler of Babylonia. Gifted with long life, may you see the fourth generation of your descendants and the blossoming of your Nation into the brightest light of the Old World.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Ḫammu-Rāpi (𒄩𒄠𒈬𒊏𒁉), paragon of just rulers, held as divine in his own time, set to become the very symbol of justice and law for millennia to come. [character], your father, has turned Babylon from a minor city into an actual state and will be proudly remembered as its first king... But his health is failing, and you are the new King. It falls to you, with the benediction of Marduk (𒀭𒀫𒌓), to make Babylon the center of an empire to be remembered for as long as mankind stands proud. Let you bring law and justice to the Old World!

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Kurigalzu (𒆪𒊑𒃲𒍪), Builder King of the great city of Babylon. Your father [character] heroically defended the realm from raids and pillage, but you will be remembered as a great Builder Archetype and will bring great prestige to Babylonian cities. Under your rule Babylonia will flourish into the brightest gem of the Old World.

events.author: nolegskitten
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Nabû-Kudurri-Uṣur (𒁹𒀭𒀝𒃻𒁺𒋀), first of the name, son of [character], fourth King of the second dynasty of Isin, ruler of Babylon in the name of Marduk (𒀭𒀫𒌓) - its true king. Babylonia has greatly suffered in recent events. As the lament goes, "The lord became angry and got furious. He gave the command, and the gods of the land abandoned it." You, however, are the new king. Blessed by Marduk, you will vanquish Babylonia's enemies and restore it back as a dominant power in the Old World. Your name will forever inspire Babylonia to greatness.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the founder-queen of Carthage. Escaping from the tyrannical rule of your brother, King [character], you have set off across the sea to found a new city. The cruel murder of your husband and the threat of Tyre leaves your legacy at stake. But all is not lost. Your natural skills of diplomacy and persuasion encouraged many people to follow you to this Old World, skills that will help to make allies for your fledgling nation. The existing civilizations do not yet know the riches and power of Carthage, but they will learn.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the man born to change the course of history. Your father was Hamilcar Barca, a military leader, and you were just nine years old when you swore an oath to follow in his footsteps. In one of his many battles, your father drowned and your brother in law Hasdrubal took over. You built your military career as a commander in Hasdrubal's army. Assassins have now taken Hamilcar's life and it falls to you, [character], to continue your family's legacy. Your two younger brothers will stand by your side. Go forth, fulfill the oath you swore to your father, and make [rival] the greatest power in the Old World!

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], a man of great wealth and noble birth. You are ready to conquer but you understand that conquest is not an end in itself. The conquered lands must be used and developed, so they may enrich the empire and the one who owns the land. Especially when that owner is you. With cunning and mercenary swords, you will yet become the richest ruler in the Old World!

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], a leader from a most distinguished family. Your thirst for exploration is endless. It is your innermost ambition to discover all there is beyond our borders. If you commission scouts to send far and wide, you know you will discover new sources of riches and new allies, perhaps even enemies that you will have to deal with, but you are prepared for that as well. Gather your people and get ready to discover the entirety of the Old World!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the Righteous King of the Chera and of [rival]. Even before taking the crown, you have achieved supremacy for your family through careful trade and negotiation, interceding in the disputes of other families when the chance arises. Diplomacy is a sea like any other, one to be navigated in return for the highest profit. The world is bursting with potential trade and riches, guided by the people of [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Pharaoh of Egypt and the divine voice of Amun. Inheriting the throne from your dead husband, you have united the tribes of Egypt to guide your people into the unknown of this Old World. You have used every power at your disposal to secure the throne and now look to the future. Your legacy is secured by two contenders, your daughter [character] and [character], your husband’s son by the concubine [character]. The existing civilizations do not yet know the splendor and riches of Egypt, but they will learn.

events.author: Dale
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of the Eighteenth Dynasty. You believe there is only one true God and will do anything to ensure all of Egypt worships Aten. Polytheism is heresy and outlawed in your vision for Egypt. While many call your views controversial, you are still able to incite fanaticism in those who hear you speak about your beliefs. Some call you insane, but you prefer to think of yourself as divinely focused. Use your focus to spread the glory of Aten to all in the Old World!

events.author: Dale
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of the Fourth Dynasty, the builder of The Great Pyramid. Your father Pharaoh Sneferu learned much about building monuments while he perfected how to build pyramids. This knowledge will be very handy for your rule. Your father has passed to Sekhet A'Aru, and it is now your time. Call the Royal Architect and your Vizier. Egypt's Wonders will stun everyone in the Old World!

events.author: Dale
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of the Eleventh Dynasty, the founder of the Middle Kingdom. In a time when Egypt was divided, you rose to rule Upper Egypt. An uprising in Herakleopolis gave you the perfect opportunity to march in and take the crown of Lower Egypt as well. Using your exceptional skills as an administrator you quickly centralized all of Egypt's power under your rule. Being able to keep the Great Families happy, while at the same time making potential usurpers disappear, worked to solidify you as the only power in Egypt. Now use your administrative genius to expand Egyptian power throughout the Old World!

events.author: Dale
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of the First Dynasty, the first woman to rule Egypt by her own right. Your Great-Grandfather Pharaoh Narmer was the first to unite the tribes of the Nile and founded the First Dynasty. Our family's understanding of how to navigate the Nile has led to us learning to exploit these connections in expanding Egypt. As the Great-Granddaughter of the mighty Pharaoh Narmer, kin to previous Pharaohs, and the one who buried your husband Pharaoh Djet, there is no stronger claim to rule than yours. Pick up your spear, and lead Egypt to greatness in the Old World!

events.author: Dale
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of the Nineteenth Dynasty, "Him who is born by Ra". You hail from the northern Ramesside family and grew up on the back of a chariot. You know absolutely everything there is to know about chariots and mobile strategic warfare. You were also a keen student of ruling and watched and learned from your father, Pharaoh Seti I. Many in Egypt have high hopes of you being a Great ruler, maybe even the Greatest Egyptian Pharaoh of them all. Combine your skills in ruling with your chariot mastery and lead Egypt to glory in the Old World!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] the Macedonian, the uniter of Greece. Seizing the kingship from your nephew, you have risen to the top with shrewd diplomacy and military might, leading the now united people of Greece into this Old World. Your fifth wife [character] has borne you an heir, [character], already showing an aptitude for military strategy beyond all others. The existing civilizations of this Old World do not yet know the strength and knowledge of Greece, but they will learn.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the young and extremely ambitious king. Your father might have been the greatest conqueror in Greek history but you were only thirteen when you convinced him that you would one day surpass his fame. After your father's assassination, you became king and you are ready to ride the mighty Bucephalus to victory. Your closest allies on the court are your mother [character], a master of political intrigue, and your tutor [character] who has taught you since you were a child. With your unmatched skill, endless thirst for power and an education from the greatest contemporary thinker, you will show why you are the greatest conqueror in the Old World.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the seventeenth Agiad King of Sparta and you trace your ancestry to Heracles himself. Your elder brother Dorieus had expected to inherit the throne and was so outraged at being bypassed that he left to try and colonize far-away Libyan lands. Of all the Spartan youths, you were superior in the long and grueling training. Your understanding of military tactics is excellent and your own physical prowess is as great as any mortal's. You stand ready to lead [rival] no matter what challenges it may face, with your wife [character] ready to fight by your side. The time has come for all to learn that you, [character], are the greatest warrior in Old World.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the First Citizen of Athens. You rule by merit, not by birthright. As a quiet youth, you immersed yourself in the study of music, philosophy and rhetoric. Later you made a name for yourself in politics and, with time, your education came to also include military matters, at which you proved adept. Now you are recognized as a great statesman and orator, and also respected as a military leader, but your fame does not extend far from your home city. It is up to you to show everyone why you are the most versatile statesman in the Old World.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], also called Soter - the Savior. You have been a bodyguard of the great Alexander, and have accompanied him into many battles. You were a very skilled warrior in your younger days but age has taken its toll on you, as it does on all mortals. You have become a scholar and a historian, working on documenting your people's past and you believe that scientific pursuits will lead to a brighter future. [character] is your wife by whom you have a son and a daughter. The future of your dynasty is secure but you still have a number of years left on the throne. Your rule shall be known as the time when a new great power emerged out of the Old World.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: [character] is dead. With the help of your accomplice and son-in-law, [character], you have taken the throne and stand ready to lead [rival] forward. With many enemies within and without our borders, you make it a priority to build Walls around all new [rival] cities.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [nation] in the Old World

options.text: I will eliminate the hostile tribes that threaten us.
The new kingdom will soon prosper under my rule.
I will find my own way.

events.text: You are [character], the young King of [rival]. Your father, the great Suppiluliuma, recently fell to the plague, which soon after claimed his successor and your brother, Arnuwanda II. You find yourself now thrust into the role of ruler of a nation with many enemies. Some are calling you Inexperienced. How will you prove your worth and honor your forebears’ legacy?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], [title] of the [rival]. With your Sickly husband [character] frequently ill, you have taken on the leadership of the nation. In addition to handling diplomatic relations abroad and judicial matters at home, you have put much time into unifying and rationalizing the various aspects of Pagan Hittite, a process known as Syncretism.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], ready to lead [rival] following the death of your father, [character]. By your father's side, you saved the failing [rival] empire. It was only natural that you take control in place of your brother, [character], who is no longer in the way. Eager and Ambitious, you have many big plans for [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], warrior king of the [rival]. First called Labarnas, you have earned your throne-name of [character] through fighting to unite the heartlands. Although the people now stand behind you, there is still the threat of intrigue. Your family will need to be brought in line if [rival] is to become a grand nation to surpass the kingdom of your forefathers. The established civilizations of this Old World do not yet know of the strength and splendor of [rival], but they will learn.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] the Kushan, the righteous, the just, the autocrat, the god. A mighty leader in your own right, your greatest strength is the knowledge that military might alone is not enough to see an Empire reach its zenith. You have long observed the strength that religion brings, how it unites people and brings organization and administration that can be utilized by a keen-minded ruler. Go forth, and push the [rival] to new lands, new gods, and a new age under your rule.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], horse trader and leader of the [rival]. Although an unknown to the great rulers of the world, you have guided your people to build a foothold in this land, making your own path through adroit negotiation and trade. Your horses are a prized commodity and you have learned to use this advantage to bring luxury and power to your people. This is a new age for the [rival]. It is time for you to settle and become a great power of your own.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], King of Magadha and the Mauryan Empire. Your rule was no certainty; it is only by proving your ability as Viceroy and overcoming your brothers’ disputes that you have been able to take the throne. To cement your rule, you have taken the princess [character] as a second wife alongside [character], your first love, the daughter of a merchant. Now, with the support of the court secured, you are ready to lead your people to new heights. The other rulers of this land are out of balance. You will show them the commitment to dharma that an empire needs to grow and prosper. You will show them the model of true kingship.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Nedum Cheralathan, the Chera King of [rival]. Rising to the throne has been a pure feat of strength. Through force of arms, you have dominated the Chola and Pandya leaders to create an uneasy alliance under your rule. Now you look further, to lands outside of your own. Even the furthest reaches of the world will feel your mark. You are willing to take any path to victory. It is a trait that will get you far.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Nedunjeliyan II, the Pandya King of [rival]. After taking the throne, you were immediately beset upon by Chera and Chola invaders. Defeating their forces and pursuing their retreating armies to their homelands, you have secured a temporary supremacy for your family among the lords of [rival]. Your rule is a chance for peace, for poetry and trade to flourish, protected by your hand. If pushed, you are ready to fight once again.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the king-of-kings and ruler of Persia. Named king upon your father’s death, you have had to fight for independence from other rulers to whom your ancestors paid tribute, even seizing the throne from your grandfather [character], the last king of Media. Finally free and at the head of the united nation of Persia, you are positioned to lead your people into the dangers and opportunities of the Old World. The existing civilizations of this Old World do not yet know the strength and splendor of Persia, but they will learn.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], son of Phraortes, King of the Medes. Your father led a revolt against the greatest powers of the region and fell in battle, failing in his attempt to restore our kingdom to power. Great challenges await you, as [rival] is surrounded by hostile nomads and aggressive empires. Your only choice is to raise an army, take your sword, and lead the charge. Fail, and you will be soon forgotten along with your kingdom. Succeed, and your name will be feared and admired in all of the Old World.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are Darayauš, or [character] as speakers of foreign tongues call you. The eldest of five sons, your family was not destined to rule but a peculiar set of events brought you to the throne. The heir apparent, Cambyses, went insane and murdered his brother Bardiya only to succumb to illness himself. The murder remained unknown to most people, so an impostor seized the opportunity, calling himself [character] and pretending to be the legitimate king. You deposed the impostor, proclaimed yourself to be descended from the most noble of [rival] families, and so now it falls onto you to lead [rival] in the Old World.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of the House of Sassan, which your father Ardashir named so in honor of a great ancestor. Your family is not native to the region but, having settled in Persis, it fell upon your bloodline to build a new empire where earlier ones fell. Your father considered you the bravest and wisest of all his children, as you proved yourself in combat against the Parthians. You are now a ruler in your own right and it is your responsibility to continue on your father's path and make Eranshahr a great empire that will outshine the Achaemenid legacy in the Old World.

events.author: Solver
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], born into nobility and risen to royalty. Your husband Arses married you in the hopes of having powerful political allies to back him as king. Arses came close to his goal, being named heir by his father, and he took on the name Artaxerxes but, by any name, his younger brother Cyrus remains jealous and wishes to see your husband dead. While your husband is king, it is his mother Parysatis who has the real power. Parysatis had all your siblings killed and is still trying to replace Artaxerxes with her other son. She may be wicked and devious but you are a most beloved queen, held in high esteem by your husband and by the people. If you can come out on top against Parysatis, you will be the true queen of [rival] in the Old World.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], first king of the Romans. Cast into a river and left to die as a baby, you were found and raised by a she-wolf. Years later, stronger and trained for your return to the World of Man, you were reunited with your birth mother, [character]. Together with your jealous twin brother, [character], you have fought tooth and nail to unite the disparate tribes of your people. You have now set out to find a place for your new city. The existing civilizations of this Old World do not yet know the power and might of Rome, but they will learn.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], leader of the [rival]. Forced from your home by the Xiongnu and pursued west by their armies, you have stepped up to fill the void in leadership after your son was killed by the rival tribe. Leading your people away from the lands of the Han Empire, you have found this new land to settle. The people look to you for guidance as they make this transition away from Nomadic life. May your reign be the start of a new age for the tribes of the [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the Chola King of [rival]. Escaping from imprisonment at the hands of your enemies, you have rallied the forces of [rival] behind you to take your revenge and seize control of the throne. Further victories against the neighboring Chera and Pandya families have created a tenuous alliance under your command. The crown and command are yours. The world awaits to see what the Tamils will achieve.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Kushan Emperor and King of Kings. Your people have consolidated their hold over the land. Following in the steps of [character], you have taken the titles of King and Emperor. As the [rival] adjust to settled life, they are adopting elements of the cultures around them to create a new synthesis of Kushan culture. It falls to you to take the reins of this new age. The Kushan Empire is still in its infancy, but your guidance will see the [rival] expand to new reaches.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], King of the [rival] and founder of the Kushan Empire. For generations, the Yuezhi have been led by five war leaders acting in harmony. No longer. In a bold stroke, you have exterminated the other four leaders, taking the new title of King for yourself. With the full force of the united tribes behind you, you have led swift and decisive strikes to provide your people with a place to settle. These new lands are a fertile ground for your Kushan Empire. Full of ambitions for the future of the Yuezhi, it is up to you to lead them into this world.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: [nation] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] of [nation], a young nation in an Old World - an Old World full of established powers that have not heard of you... yet. Select your Settler and found your Capital City. You'll also decide which Family manages your first City, gaining their advantages immediately.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], great King of [rival]. A champion of your faith, you have brought down the sword upon those who would persecute your fellow believers. Your shrewdness as a Commander Archetype and your unwavering piety will take you far. It is early in your reign. With your young family by your side, your dynasty's greatest achievements lie before you.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Evangelist King of [rival]. Considered in your youth a son of Mahrem, the Aksumite god of war, your faith soon shifted to Christianity. Under the guidance of your foreign tutor, [character], your faith became unshakable, and Christianity is destined to play a grand part in your rule. With the might of God behind you, who shall dare stand in your way?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character] the Subjugator, ready to expand your mighty kingdom. The reach of [rival] must be broadened. Those who do not bend to your rule must be broken. Your nation may be a mere city state today, but it is bound for greatness!

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], conquering Queen of [rival]. Exiled in your youth, you have returned home with a vengeance, laying waste to the [rival] of old. You are ready to build it anew and to Intimidate into submission any who stand in your way.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], known in legend as the Queen of Sheba. [rival] is your home, but your influence knows no borders. Whether you choose to Lead Delegation to strengthen ties with your neighbors or crush them with military might is now up to you. Your young nation awaits your first command.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: All hail the Kandake and Qore, [character], ruler of the lands of the bow. You have overcome every challenge to your rule, wielding both diplomacy and the blade with an equal determination. The once disparate tribes now stand united under your swift and decisive leadership. The legacy of your dynasty lives on through your son, [character], a promising warrior with the potential to follow you as a great King, if he can overcome his regular illnesses. The existing civilizations of this Old World do not yet know the strength and splendor of [rival], but they will learn.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the ruler of the lands of Kush. Having united the disparate tribes of Nubia, the time is right for you to found a new city dedicated to Amani. As your gaze rests upon the future, you envision a world where Kush stands above all, supported by the gods. Your brother and heir [character] lends his prowess to your cause, encouraging the conquering of neighboring lands. Your rule will path the way for greatness, the future kings and queens of [rival] invoking the name of the great [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], the Queen and Kandake of Kush. The path to authority has been tough, with rebels and invaders at every turn. You were not merciful. Now it is time to rebuild stronger than ever before, with [character] by your side. None can match your diligent planning, which is turned towards crafting wondrous cities and temples to be envied by all. The works you leave will be a lasting legacy that will secure the place of [rival] in the eyes of the gods and the records of history. Lead [rival] forwards to piety and prosperity!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Qore of Napata and Kush. A direct descendant of Alara, you rule by the might of your bow. It is time to take up your weapons once more; you have been called to lead your armies in a Holy War for Amani to take the lands of your neighbors to become the Pharaoh you were born to be. Secure the throne for your heir, [character], and your dynasty will secure the favor of the god of Kush. With your divine might, none will be able to stand before the armies of [rival]!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [rival] in the Old World
events.text: You are [character], Son of Ra, Lord of the Two Lands and the first Queen of Kush. To outsiders your people have often been overshadowed by their relations with Egypt, but under your rule the culture of [rival] is blossoming. It is a time of craft, of trade, and of prosperity. Your artisans now write in Meroitic text, all the better to give praise to the gods of Kush who have granted you the throne. Your authority is unquestioned. Although you rule alone, your dynasty will need to be secured to establish your nation's place in this world.
